limitations: GPU intervals are measured. Source-order attribution is an extraction result; unresolved events remain in the full-GPU summary.
Observed forward order and bounded log token counts identify chunks only where their explicit join succeeded. Context accumulation uses the stated single-request FIFO inference.
The tree owns each attributed event once. Fused kernels remain complete operators; no duration is copied into multiple semantic leaves.
Model FLOPs and useful bytes are unavailable without an explicit, complete, event-set-bound work review. Timing attribution alone does not qualify their numerators.
Useful-byte MBU is an interface estimate against nominal per-GPU bandwidth. It is not measured HBM traffic; counter MBU remains separate.
Raw symbols, host/process identities, corpus content, annotations and private source paths are excluded from this public pack.
Nsight reported that some CUDA or NVTX records might not have been collected. GPU totals describe captured activity; complete execution coverage is not certified.
Full-request execution coverage has not passed independent review; request MFU remains unavailable.

546 retained NCCL kernels (273 send, 273 receive) have audited communication identity and direction. Their forward ownership, peer, communicator and message bytes remain unavailable. Residency includes waiting and is not a recoverable-time estimate.

target_model_work.scope: 78 target layers, 21 causal indexer refreshes, eight useful expert routes, final iHC projection over 100,000 rows and one vocabulary projection. Excludes draft/NEXTN, implementation padding, additional chunk logits and scalar semantic operations.

timeline.clock_evidence: One captured single-host Nsight timestamp domain; original per-rank offsets are preserved.
